method: Native deletion callback, path builders, file-list constructor/destructor and SEH chain; enumeration, unlink, directory removal, deallocation and registry reload are controlled endpoints.
safety_difference: C skips a file path exceeding the native 260-byte stack buffer; this malformed case is a separate C check.
limitations: Exact paths/call order/lifetime are compared. Filesystem deletion and the complete modal/registry loop are separate integration checks.
